body_markdown:
**VICTOR, N.Y.** – Broadstone Net Lease, Inc. (NYSE: BNL) (“BNL”, the “Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), today announced its operating results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY


*“We delivered a strong third quarter, generating AFFO growth of 5.4% year-over-year, as our portfolio continued to perform well and our pipeline matured as expected,”* said John Moragne, BNL’s Chief Executive Officer *. “During the quarter, we were thrilled to return to the public equity markets and complete our $259 million public equity offering – a milestone we are proud of after four years away. Combined with a committed build-to-suit pipeline of $456 million as of today, we have our capital already at work and our path forward clearly defined. With a strengthened balance sheet and the continued confidence of our tenant and developer partners, we believe we remain on track to deliver on our full-year guidance and are energized by what lies ahead.”*


To download a PDF of the full press release,[click here](https://broadstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Earnings-Release-Q3-2026.pdf) .
